title: Add empty and root-resolving arguments to the hardening checklist
body:
Outcome: docs/program/hardening-checklist.md names argument inputs: an empty argument, ".", "..", an absolute path or a symlink that resolves to an ancestor of the intended root is refused, never widened into a larger selection; krn brief check keeps accepting the existing classes (extend `malformed` or add one class, with the brief-hardening tests updated).
Evidence: PR #163 review attempt 1 was lost to a prepass BLOCKING finding: selectTestFiles([""]) resolved to the project root and selected every test (record .krn/archive/review-series-af9fd99ac4ea2f35fa7551eb0ae2a77f48ff8b733bfcaea6629dabe79fdca616/records/1.json). The brief's Hardening section answered `malformed` for records only, so no class asked for the case.
Proof: brief-hardening observer red at base (the new class id is required), green at head.
